name: Social problems have attracted widespread attention in recent years.
trans: 近年来，社会问题引起了广泛关注。

name: The aging population has become a serious social issue in China.
trans: 人口老龄化已成为中国一个严重的社会问题。

name: We should care for the elderly and improve their quality of life.
trans: 我们应关爱老年人，提高他们的生活质量。

name: College graduates are faced with great employment pressure.
trans: 大学毕业生面临很大的就业压力。

name: The government has taken measures to reduce poverty and narrow the income gap.
trans: 政府已采取措施减少贫困、缩小收入差距。

name: The urban-rural gap still exists in some areas.
trans: 城乡差距在一些地区仍然存在。

name: Urbanization has brought both opportunities and challenges.
trans: 城市化既带来了机遇，也带来了挑战。

name: Public transportation can reduce traffic pressure and improve air quality.
trans: 公共交通能减轻交通压力、改善空气质量。

name: Volunteer work is a good way to make a contribution to society.
trans: 志愿工作是服务社会的好方式。

name: Community service helps build a harmonious society.
trans: 社区服务有助于建设和谐社会。

name: Everyone has a social responsibility to protect the environment.
trans: 每个人都有保护环境的社会责任。

name: We should raise public awareness of social responsibility.
trans: 我们应提高公众的社会责任意识。

name: Some elderly people may suffer from loneliness and need more care.
trans: 一些老年人可能遭受孤独，需要更多关爱。

name: It is necessary for the government and citizens to work together.
trans: 政府和公民有必要共同努力。

name: Only by joint efforts can we build a more harmonious society.
trans: 只有共同努力，我们才能建设更加和谐的社会。
